title: Jesus... How Long Am I Supposed To Keep Asking?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus, how long am I supposed to keep asking?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Same prayer. Two years. Word for word.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Are you asking for permission to stop?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Maybe. I am tired of hearing my own voice.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then stop performing it and just sit here. I do not need the same sentence to know.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Silence feels like You are not answering.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Silence is not absence. I am not the kind of God who leaves the room when I am quiet.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why not just say yes?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Because sometimes the yes you want would cost you the thing you actually need.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I know. Watch in hope. I hear you. I have heard every one.

bible.text: But as for me, I watch in hope for the Lord, I wait for God my Savior; my God will hear me.
